WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT
    archstat,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(cnt) as total_cnt,
    COUNT(*) as num_statuses
  FROM status_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT
    sc.archstat,
    sc.cnt,
    CAST(sc.cnt AS FLOAT) / t.total_cnt as share,
    1.0 / CAST(t.num_statuses AS FLOAT) as avg_share
  FROM status_counts sc
  CROSS JOIN totals t
)
SELECT
  archstat,
  cnt as count,
  share,
  share - avg_share as above_avg
FROM with_shares
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY share DESC;

assumptions.assumption: The archival status column `archstat` in table `scanqc` is the source of status categories.
NULL or missing values in `archstat` are grouped as a distinct category, not excluded.
Average share is the arithmetic mean of all status shares: 1.0 / (number of distinct statuses), since all shares sum to 1.
